findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 434 requests to 113 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 63.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 7.0 MB (11%) came from third-party domains, 2.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (286 requests).

65 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads-twitter.com (X, advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising).
195 cookies were set by third-party domains (247 cookies in total).
